title: AI Solutions Architect | Cloud & GenAI Systems
summary: AI solutions architect focused on production GenAI systems, retrieval, and enterprise automation, with 15+ years across QA, software delivery, and enterprise platforms. Founded a consultancy delivering 120+ GenAI applications and 90+ AI chatbots for 30+ clients. Architected a multi-model stack using OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini at Assent, with live RAG integrations and governance controls. Brings GCP, AWS, and web platform skills alongside a foundation in software quality and delivery.
